html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The resurrection of an ancient Mutant 
and the desperate battle of the X-Men across time and space begin!

 

We are excited to introduce the June Update, 
inspired by Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97 Season 2.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Apocalypse, Magneto, and Jubilee, 
who are fighting an all-out war on this treacherous battlefield. 
In addition, Jubilee, the master of powerful explosive abilities 
through plasmoid manipulation, has received her Tier-4 Advancement.

 

Furthermore, Morph, the shapeshifter capable of copying the appearance and abilities of others, 
has prepared his Tier-3 power and joined MARVEL Future Fight.

 

We have also reworked Shadowland by adding a new Challenge Mode 
and improving the Batch Sweep feature for the existing Normal Mode.

 

Please check below for more details on these and various other improvements designed 
to make your gameplay experience more convenient!

 

 

 

▣ One New Hero

Check out the abilities of Morph <Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97>, 
the mood maker of the X-Men and a shapeshifter who can mimic anyone and copy their abilities!
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms


To celebrate the Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97 Season 2 inspired update,
three new uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Young Apocalypse <Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97>, 
Magneto <Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97>, and Jubilee <Marvel Animation’s X-Men '97>.  
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <June Update Celebration Event> 

and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Jubilee Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Jubilee, 
an action-oriented Super Hero whose loyalty and devotion to her teammates are second to none.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Morph Tier-3

 

Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been added for Morph. 
The master of shapeshifting will stir up the battlefield by making full use of his abilities.

 

 

 

 

▣ Shadowland Rework 

 

A new Challenge Mode has been added to Shadowland, 
the content where you challenge the top floor by clearing stages with various combat styles.

 

 

① Shadowland (Challenge)
Upon clearing Floor 35 of Shadowland (Normal), 
the Challenge Mode will be unlocked, allowing you to face truly powerful enemies. 
This mode has the following features:

- There are entry conditions for each floor.
- Unlike Normal Mode, your highest reached floor will not reset.
- The Set Team option via All Team Effects is unavailable during team selection.
- Heroes used on other floors can be reused.

 

 

- Enemies in Challenge Mode are much stronger than those in Normal Mode. We wish our Agents the best of luck!

 

[Challenge Mode First Clear Reward] 

 


② Shadowland (Normal) 
A Sweep All feature has been added, and Sweep Tickets will be consumed upon clearing each floor.
* Floors will be cleared using the heroes you used in the previous season (Up to Floor 35).
If you have already used a previous season's hero on a specific floor, you can sweep up to the floor just below it.

 

 

③ King of the Hill
The 'King of the Hill' mode will conclude with this update. 
Rewards have been distributed to Agents who participated as follows:

 

▶ Conqueror Reward
- Target: The 1 Agent with the highest total number of successful defenses while holding the throne during the final season.
- Reward: 2,000 Crystals

 

▶ Challenger Reward
- Rewards based on Challenger Ranking (Rank Rewards, Percentage Rewards).

 

▶ King of the Hill Reward
- Target: The Agent who was the Master of Shadowland on the day of the update.
- Reward: 5,000,000 Gold

 

④ Product Adjustments
The special effects provided by the S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Special Support+ product have been changed as follows:
- Obtain 5 bonus Shadowland Token in Shadowland (Normal) Floors 1 - 35
- Shadowland Tokens in Shadowland (Normal) Floor 36 and up +10%

 

⑤ Other Changes
- Content Selection Menu (Challenge Tab): The display showing the current floor number for Shadowland has been removed.

 


▣ New Artifact

 

After the June update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Morph will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[June Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97 Season 2.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Update Hot Deals

 

Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 6/23 Maintenance - 7/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 6/23 Maintenance - 7/21 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Story: Improved so that the bonus acquisition chance increase will apply if you meet the possession/growth conditions for the designated characters, even if they do not join the team as active participants.
- Due to this improvement, 'Selected Character Bonus' has been renamed to 'Owned Character Bonus', and the 'Auto Use Designated Characters' option in Auto Progress has been removed.
* The Owned Character Bonus will change after the update maintenance.
* Following this, the Owned Character Bonus will change on the 1st of every month, just like the previous system.

- Certain stage special bonus effects have been removed to ensure smoother Auto Progress for Agents.

 

 

2. New restriction conditions have been added to the following contents:
① Otherworld Battle: A Restricted Characters system has been added. 
- This will apply to all leagues starting from Season 22, and Native Tier-2 and Tier-3 characters will be designated as restricted characters.
* Please note that this restriction condition will not be permanently applied every season.

 

② Team Battle Arena: Native Tier-2 and Tier-3 conditions have been added to the banned characters criteria.
* Please note that this restriction condition will be applied differently depending on each league and will not be permanently applied every season.

 

3. ISO-8: Enhance/Combine systems have been improved.
① Enhance All
- The maximum quantity that can be enhanced at once has been increased from 10 → 20.

 

② Combine All
A new Combine All menu has been added to combine multiple ISO-8 at once. 

Tapping an ISO-8 that has reached +5 Enhancement will reveal a Combine All checkbox at the bottom right of the screen. Checking it activates the Combine All button.

 

 

When proceeding with Combine All, you can select the 'Target Option' and 'Grade' to proceed.
ⓐ. Combination Target: ISO-8 that possess the options you want to use as the target for the batch combine.
Combination Material: ISO-8 that do not possess the target options and will be used as materials.
ⓑ. Combination Grade: The rank that includes the ISO-8 to be used as targets and materials.
* Locked ISO-8 will be excluded from Combine All.
*  ISO-8 matching the selected target options are set by default to not be used as materials. However, if you check 'ⓒ Include materials with the same options as the combination target', ISO-8 with the same options can also be used as combination materials.

 

- You can select the option to be used as a material for Combine by using the button on the top right of ⓐ.

 

- Select the option you wish to grow to designate ISO-8 with that option as the combination target.

 

4. A filter feature has been added to prevent Premium Characters from being consumed as materials during Character Level Up.
- Target Items: Daily Biometrics, Daily X-Genes, Store Characters (Character Acquisition products)

 

 

5. Dimension Mission: Improved so that if you attempt to Sweep while there are obtainable Contribution Rewards left, a notification screen will inform you of the remaining rewards before proceeding.

 

 

You can check the relevant information and claim your rewards through the Contribution Reward pop-up that appears when tapping the Contribution Reward icon. 

 

 

6. World Boss (Ultimate, Legend, Legend+): Eased the unlock conditions for certain stages and removed certain challenges.
- Eased the unlock challenges for World Boss Stage 10 and above.
- Reduced the required number of clears for specific stage clear challenges. (Max 15 times → 6 times)
- Reduced the required number of clears with specific characters for stage clear challenges. (Max 5 times → 2 times)

 

7. Card Collection: Improved so that a Red Dot will display on the 'Complete Collection' button for themes where the collection conditions are fully met.

 

8. Skill Training Room: Improved so that a confirmation pop-up appears before entering the content.

 

9. Zombie Survival: Improved so that tapping the 'Acquire All' button in challenges will also claim completed Weekly Challenge rewards in bulk.

 

10. Pass Products: Improved so that the navigation notifications would not be displayed after reaching the maximum level and claiming all rewards.

 

11. Event (Hero Pursuit): Improved so that completing a challenge will display a navigation notification, allowing you to jump directly to the challenge list through the alert.

 

12.  A warning pop-up will now appear if you select an uncrafted Premium Comic Card as a material when changing normal options or crafting cards.

 

13. Improved so that tapping an Emblem in the acquired reward list in Inbox (Chest) will display its name.

 

14. Added 25 new trivia quizzes and removed 1 duplicate trivia quiz.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
